data.description:
## Context
src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py is 795 LOC — 5 lines under the absolute 800 hard cap enforced by the CI module-size gate (.github/module-size-limit.txt). Any small addition trips the build red. It has ZERO in-progress file_impact contention. The audit (ae1b) flagged near-cap modules as MEDIUM-HIGH maintainability debt.

## Plan
- Read the module whole; identify an existing call-graph seam (a cluster of functions that already call one another) per AGENTS.md module-size policy.
- Extract that cluster into a new sibling module (>=100 LOC) and update imports; do NOT split mechanically to hit a number and do NOT create files <100 LOC.
- Keep the public surface of structured_run.py unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py is at/below the 500-LOC target.
- [ ] Any new sibling module is >=100 LOC and split along a pre-existing seam.
- [ ] No public import path changes for callers; module-size gate green; full type/lint/test gates green.

## Non-overlap
Touches only src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py and a new sibling under src/rebar/llm/ — both free of in-progress contention.
data.title: Split near-cap module structured_run.py (795 LOC) below the 500-LOC target
